environment.description: Deployed behind Envoy proxy (v1.28) with a custom ext_authz filter chain. The ext_authz service implements a token-binding verification: each ws_token issued by /api/ws-auth is cryptographically bound to the TLS client session (using the tls_session_id from the downstream connection metadata extracted via Envoy's %DOWNSTREAM_TLS_SESSION_ID% variable). When /ws/connect is called, the ext_authz filter extracts the current connection's TLS session ID and verifies it matches the session ID recorded at token issuance time. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration for /api/ws-auth includes a custom header requirement: x-csrf-binding must be present and match a per-page nonce served via the application's HTML (enforced in the ext_authz filter, not in application code). The secret rotation cycle is 60 seconds with token map eviction synchronized to rotation (tokens issued with the previous secret are purged on rotation). Envoy listener configured with connection_limit of 100 per source IP with circuit_breakers preventing token farming.

config.ext_authz_policy: token-to-tls-session-binding verification on /ws/connect; x-csrf-binding header required on /api/ws-auth
config.tls_session_binding: DOWNSTREAM_TLS_SESSION_ID bound to issued token at ext_authz layer
config.token_eviction: tokens purged on 60s rotation cycle (synchronized with secret rotation)
config.connection_limit: 100 per source IP via Envoy circuit breaker
config.csrf_nonce: x-csrf-binding header validated against server-side nonce pool in ext_authz
